basic_details.job_title: NEIGRIHMS Project Technical Support I Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: North Eastern Indira Gandhi Regional Institute of Health & Medical Science (NEIGRIHMS), Shillong, an autonomous institute under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, has invited applicants for a walk-in interview for 2 contractual posts of Project Technical Support-I under an ICMR-funded project. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 23 October 2026, starting at 10:00 AM at Room no: 103, 1st Floor, OPD Department of Anaesthesiology and Critical Care, NEIGRIHMS, Shillong.

faq.question: Q1. When is the NEIGRIHMS Project Technical Support-I walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 23rd October 2026 starting at 10:00 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q2. What is the venue for the NEIGRIHMS walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Room no: 103, 1st Floor, OPD Department of Anaesthesiology and Critical Care, NEIGRIHMS, Shillong.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Project Technical Support-I contractual post.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Only applicants who have applied for the contractual posts based on the advertisement dated 7th Oct 2026 are requested to attend the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q5. What documents are required to be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents, relevant certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q6. What time should candidates reach the interview venue?
faq.answer: Candidates are requested to reach at least half an hour before the interview begins.

faq.question: Q7. Which department is conducting this recruitment project?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Department of Anaesthesiology, NEIGRIHMS, Shillong, under an ICMR-funded project.
